SELECT cls,
       CAST(fish_date_doy/7 AS INT)*7 AS week,
       SUM(yt) AS yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS share,
       COUNT(*) AS boat_days
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 56 AND 91
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter','hd_pm','hd_am')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
